title: Food Wars! The Second Plate OVA (食戟のソーマ 弐ノ皿 OVA)
summary: AniList 98702 is the TWO-episode OVA that shipped on the DVDs packed inside the アニメDVD同梱版 of tankōbon volumes 24 (2017-05-02, 「ようこそ決戦の地へ」, ISBN 978-4-08-908289-8) and 25 (2017-07-04, 「落ちこぼれの生き方」, ISBN 978-4-08-908290-4) — ja-WP's manga bibliography and the Second Plate official site both carry the two 同梱版 pages, dアニメストア files the work as 「食戟のソーマ 弐ノ皿 OVA（全2話）」 and Bandai Channel gives the runtimes: 第1話「秋月のめぐり逢い」(24分) and 第2話「遠月十傑」(25分). THE TWO HALVES ARE OPPOSITES. Episode 1 is filler in the licensor's own words — the vol-24 page's あらすじ reads 「実地研修（スタジエール）を見事突破した創真たちが、温泉旅館で休息を満喫！？…普段は見ることができない、創真たちの休日を描いたアニメオリジナルストーリー！」 (an anime-original hot-spring holiday, first screened at ジャンプスペシャルアニメフェスタ2016 per ja-WP), and en-WP's OVA-3 summary is that same original story; the same disc also carries the Nakama Ryō parody short 「仲間りょう版食戟のソーマ〜浮世はまずいよ〜」, a crude-animation gag recap of the first episodes that AniList does not count. Episode 2 is a straight adaptation of the manga's Autumn Leaf Viewing (紅葉狩り会): ja-WP states 「遠月十傑」はこれまでのOVAシリーズとは違い原作の本筋が描かれ、第3期の冒頭でも一部が回想シーンとして使用された; the vol-25 licensor page's あらすじ is the event itself (「…「遠月十傑」と、秋の選抜本戦出場者たちが顔をあわせる伝統行事「紅葉狩り」。創真たちの前に現れたのは、第一席なのに気弱な性格の司をはじめ、ぬいぐるみを抱える無口な茜ヶ久保、口うるさい久我など曲者ばかり。」); shokugekinosoma.fandom's Chapter 119 page (「十傑との距離」, 'This chapter formally introduces the entire current Elite Ten Council') names this OVA in its `ep` field and the wiki's Moon Banquet Festival Arc page orders the arc's anime 37 → OVA 4 → 38; en-WP's OVA-4 summary is that chapter beat for beat (Soma challenges the Ten, they laugh it off, only Kuga sets a condition, Momo serves a sweet), which is also Shueisha's own volume-15 blurb 「初めて会う十傑に対し、食戟を申し込む創真だが、相手にされず。1年生にとっては、十傑の存在の大きさのみを知る紅葉狩り会となった…」; and MangaUpdates' coverage segment for THIS entry reads 「Vol 13, Chap 119 (S2+OVA 2)」 with S3 starting at 「Vol 14, Chap 120」 (MU's volume digits are wrong — 119 opens vol 15 — but the chapters are the load-bearing part, and the same field records skips explicitly elsewhere, e.g. 'Skips Chaps 265-272' on S5, so it is claiming continuous coverage through 119). THE SURPRISE: our ep 37 ends on ch 117 and ep 38 starts on ch 120, so chapters 118-119 are animated NOWHERE ELSE — this OVA is their sole telling and the TV run only re-shows its footage as a flashback at the top of season 3. A substantial source share (25 of the work's 49 minutes; two chapters no episode carries) beside a substantial original share (24 minutes) is MIXED under T28.

chapters_adapted.note: Episode 2 「遠月十傑」 = the Autumn Leaf Viewing 紅葉狩り会 — ch 118 「遠月十傑」 (vol 14's last chapter: the event's notice, the first-years' post-Stagiaire friction, the Elite Ten's debut) and ch 119 「十傑との距離」 (vol 15's first chapter: the Council formally introduced, Soma's blanket Shokugeki challenge brushed off, Kuga's condition, Momo's dessert). The END (119) is two-source solid: the fandom's ch-119 `ep` field names this OVA, and MU's segment for this entry ends the S2+OVA 2 block at ch 119 with S3 starting at 120; en-WP's plot summary and Shueisha's vol-15 blurb are ch 119 beat for beat. The START (118) is the softer edge — no source counts pages: it rests on MU's segment being continuous with no skip recorded (that same field records skips elsewhere), on en-WP's summary opening on the pre-arrival first-year friction that is ch 118's material, and on the OVA carrying ch 118's exact title. Neither chapter is adapted by any TV episode (ep 37 = chs 113-117, ep 38 = chs 120-121), so this is their sole animation; season 3's opening only re-shows this OVA's footage as a flashback (ja-WP). The entry crosses the vol 14 / vol 15 boundary; the volume field is the END's (15).

position.why: Confirmed — every instrument lands on the same slot, and for once the chapter position and the release slot agree. (1) CHAPTERS: the canon half adapts chs 118-119, which sit exactly in the gap between ep 37 (END 117, our anchor; the wiki's ep-37 chapter field is 113-117) and ep 38 (chs 120-121; MU's S3 start 'Vol 14, Chap 120'). (2) SETTING of the filler half: the licensor opens its synopsis 「実地研修（スタジエール）を見事突破した創真たちが…」 and en-WP says 'takes place sometime after the second season after the first years completed their Stagiaire assignments' — i.e. after ep 37 too. (3) The fandom's Moon Banquet Festival Arc page lists the arc's anime as 37, OVA 4, 38, 39, 40, 41, 42 — the OVA between 37 and 38. (4) RELEASE SLOT: 2017-05-02 and 2017-07-04 fall between ep 37 (2016-09-24) and ep 38 (2017-10-04). Watching it before ep 38 is also the only way to see the Elite Ten introduced, since S3 opens by flashing back to it.

flags_for_sean: THE FINDING WORTH CARRYING BEYOND THIS ROW: chapters 118-119 are a HOLE IN THE TV RUN that only this OVA fills. Ep 37 ends on ch 117 (stored anchor; shokugekinosoma.fandom ep-37 field 113-117) and ep 38 opens on ch 120 (fandom field 120-121; MU's S3 start 'Vol 14, Chap 120'); season 3's own opening re-shows this OVA's footage as a flashback rather than animating the Elite Ten's introduction (ja-WP: 「第3期の冒頭でも一部が回想シーンとして使用された」). Outside the ask, but it means ep 37's continue-read is honestly 118 (C1/C2 read-on, nothing to skip on arrival at ep 38) and a viewer who skips this OVA never sees the Council introduced. Worth a note on the ep-37 row if the C-layer ever touches it.

THE STANDING IS A TWO-HALVES CALL, not a close one, but say it out loud: the work is ONE AniList entity holding two separate OVAs of near-equal length (Bandai Channel: 24分 + 25分). Episode 1 「秋月のめぐり逢い」 is filler on the licensor's own label 「アニメオリジナルストーリー」; episode 2 「遠月十傑」 is a full adaptation of chs 118-119. Under T28 that is mixed. If the halo ever splits the entity into two rows, the split is: OVA 3 = filler @37.5 (vol 24 disc, 2017-05-02) and OVA 4 = canon @37.5 with chs 118-119 (vol 25 disc, 2017-07-04) — both slots are the same, so nothing about the position changes.

THE ONE SOFT EDGE: the START chapter 118. No source counts pages or names 118 explicitly; the fandom's ch-118 page has no `ep` field at all while 117, 119 and 120 do — and I checked the page history rather than reading that as a negative: the field has NEVER been present on ch 118 in any of its 25 revisions, including the two edits (2017-07-14, 2017-08-06) by Vizard6991, the same editor who created the OVA page in June 2017 and added `ep = Tōtsuki Elite Ten (OVA)` to ch 119 on 2017-07-24. That is silence with a mild lean, not a finding. I delivered 118-119 because MU's segment is continuous to 119 with no skip recorded (the same field records skips explicitly on S5), because en-WP's summary opens on ch 118's pre-arrival first-year friction, and because the OVA's title IS ch 118's title. If Sean prefers the tighter claim, the entry becomes 119-119 (same END, same volume, same position) and ch 118 is then reported as never animated.

NOT COUNTED, on purpose: the fandom's OVA-3 trivia says episode 1 dramatizes Megumi's ping-pong persona 'Hopping Hare' (東北の跳び兎), 'a detail introduced in the manga at the start of the Tōtsuki Autumn Election Arc but removed in the corresponding episodes'. The wiki's own citation for the nickname points at a different place (its Megumi page cites 'chapter 39, page 6'), the two disagree, and either way a character detail dramatized inside an original scene is not adapted chapter content — T28's sliver clause: it weighs nothing and earns no chapter entry. Named here so nobody re-discovers it later as a source tie.

DATE: AniList's stored 2017-05-01 for the work is one day early. Three sources give the vol-24 disc's street date as 2017-05-02 (火) — the Second Plate official site's comic24 page, ja-WP's volume list (「2017年5月7日発行（5月2日発売）」, ISBN 978-4-08-908289-8) and en-WP's OVA table — and the vol-25 disc as 2017-07-04 (火). I filed no repair because the context's ledger row carries no date field; if the halo stores AniList's date, 2017-05-02 is the honest value (and the work genuinely has two release dates, two months apart).

SOURCE-COUNT HONESTY: the licensor synopsis text is ONE lineage printed in three places — shokugekinosoma.com's comic24 / comic25 pages, Bandai Channel (b-ch 8231/001, 8231/002) and dアニメストア (workId 25763) all carry the same あらすじ verbatim. I counted it once. The independent legs of this verdict are: that licensor text, ja-WP's anime article, en-WP's OVA plot summaries, shokugekinosoma.fandom (chapter/episode/arc/volume pages), MangaUpdates' coverage string, and Shueisha's own volume blurbs. b-ch and dアニメ are still load-bearing for STRUCTURE (全2話, 24分 + 25分, titles).

SIBLINGS ON THE SHELF — NOT RESEARCHED HERE, do not infer from this verdict. AniList 21691 @24.5 is the S1 pair (OVA 1 「タクミの下町合戦」 vol 18, 2016-05-02; OVA 2 「夏休みのエリナ」 vol 19) and AniList 101924 @53.5 is OVA 5 「極星寮のえりな」 (vol 29, 2018-05-02). ja-WP's framing 「『遠月十傑』はこれまでのOVAシリーズとは違い原作の本筋が描かれ」 implies the earlier ones are originals and would make 21691 an easy filler, but that is an inference from one clause about a DIFFERENT work — it needs its own licensor read (the vol-18/19 同梱版 pages), and OVA 5 needs its own entirely.

AniList's GraphQL API was 403 all task ('temporarily disabled'). Nothing above was read from AniList; the staged context facts (format OVA, 2 episodes, 25 min, source tag MANGA) were only used as the starting principle, and the structure was re-verified against dアニメストア (全2話) and Bandai Channel (per-episode runtimes).
